---

```{r}
head(mtcars)
```
```{r}
pairs(mpg ~ ., data = mtcars)
```

```{r}
plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg, xlab = 'Miles / gallon', ylab = 'Weight (lbs)', title(main='mtcars mpg vs weight'))
```

```{r}
lg_model <- lm(wt~mpg, data=mtcars)
summary(lg_model)
```

```{r}
plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg, xlab = 'Miles / gallon', ylab = 'Weight (lbs)', title(main='mtcars mpg vs weight'))
abline(lg_model, col = 'red', lwd = 2)
```
